ring_geometry.source_spatial_reference: EPSG:3857 (latestWkid 3857; layer metadata reports Shape__Area/Shape__Length in esriMeters)
ring_geometry.attribute_comparison: The service Shape__Area/Shape__Length agree with direct EPSG:3857 projection of the supplied EPSG:4326 ring within precision/rounding (area difference 0.008762 m2; perimeter difference <0.000001 m). Their larger values are Web Mercator planar values, not a conflict with ground-surface geodesic measurements.
ring_geometry.assessment: The delivered ring has WGS84 geodesic area/perimeter ~473.159 m2 / 117.120 m and project-local approximate area ~472.867 m2. Its stored service fields are planar EPSG:3857 measures (~817.39 m2 / 154.003 m), which reconcile after projection. The ring traces the roof perimeter in the state current orthophoto overlay; the exterior wall line is not verified.

county_assessment.assessment_caveat: Tax parcel area is not building footprint area. FinishLivingArea/floor-area-equivalent is corroborative, not a direct floor count or measured height.

imagery.registration_method: Transform same raw feature ring to native EPSG:3857; raster bounding box and overlay vertices generated from those projected coordinates.
